# Vendored

`three.min.js` — Three.js r149, UMD build, MIT licence, © 2010–2023 Three.js Authors.

Vendored rather than loaded from a CDN so the page keeps working with no
network — the same reason the product runs on a LAN. The UMD build is used
specifically because ES modules are blocked over `file://`, and this page has to
open off a USB stick.
